authoredNote: Shape written first from the corpus file it was found in (shadcn-svelte docs/src/lib/registry/ui/chart/chart-container.svelte: `const uid = $props.id()` then `let { ref = $bindable(null), id = uid, ... } = $props()`). The three forbids name the defect, not the fix's shape.
rationale: Found by the lane's own truth (script/m14/svelte-truth.ts), which derives component ownership from the grammar: `contains chart-container -> uid` and `contains chart-tooltip -> defaultFormatter` came back with no derivable owner. `{ a = default }` is an object_assignment_pattern whose RIGHT side is a value; walking it as a container published both children as component props, and the same name list also drives the merge dedupe, so the delegate's real `uid` Constant was dropped — one binding, two false facts and the true declaration lost from the graph. The rename pair (`renamed: local`) pins the M59 value-side rule in the same destructure.

forbidRelationships.comment: the default VALUE of `id = uid` is not a component-owned binding
the rename binds `local`; the key is not a symbol (M59 #825)
a module-level const is not the component's public API
